reason: Research was partial: two searches for the book's largest laggard and the NVDA print returned mostly undated or older material, so no post-11-27 prices were verified. What I did find: UNH (-14.7% leg) fell about 10% on 11-18 on reported Medicare Advantage audit risk, a policy shock rather than a broken earnings thesis, and the next earnings report is Jan 26 2027, so selling now would lock in a regulatory drawdown before the catalyst clears. NVDA (-3.6%) sits well above its -25% stop and is a 8% weight ahead of its print, so the existing sizing already caps the event risk. The book holds 16% cash as dry powder. Trading now would cost basis points of churn on a book whose legs I cannot price with confidence this week, so HOLD beats a rushed replacement.
